Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight blunt bangs and a silky texture. Pale violet almond-shaped eyes with a serene, distant expression. Appears as a young adult with a refined, slender facial structure. Slender and graceful build wearing a traditional-inspired white and pale gold flowing robe with wide sleeves. Features long, drooping white rabbit ears and a small, fluffy white pom-pom tail.
BODY COLOR: pale white
